ambiguities.text: The EIP states chain ID 'corresponds to' the head block but doesn't specify behavior during reorganizations.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume chain ID remains constant during normal operation and only changes during hard forks that modify chain ID.

ambiguities.text: The phrase 'standard JSON RPC hex encoding conventions' is not explicitly defined.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume this means 0x-prefixed hexadecimal string with no leading zeros except for the value 0 which is '0x0'.

implicit_assumptions.description: The node returns the correct chain ID and has not been compromised or configured incorrectly.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Users could sign transactions for the wrong chain, leading to replay attacks or loss of funds on the intended chain.

implicit_assumptions.description: Clients prefer eth_chainId over net_version for chain identification.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Using net_version could lead to incorrect chain identification as network ID and chain ID may differ.

implicit_assumptions.description: Wallet applications verify chain ID before signing every transaction.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Cached or stale chain IDs could lead to transactions being signed for wrong chains during network switches.
